$comment: Retrieved from the official Cabinet Office of Sri Lanka by scripts/import-cabinet.mjs. Not hand-edited. Names are recorded exactly as the Cabinet Office writes them; identity resolution against Parliament's records happens in the adapter, which can see every source. `headingVerbatim` is the source's own label for this roster, reproduced without correction.
